answer: Trust is the currency a sybil farm cannot mint. Rank identities by short random walks on the attestation graph seeded from honest anchors, a knoll of genuine sources. Honest agents earn inbound edges from peers served; a farmer's puppets can only vouch for each other, so the cut between the honest graph and the clique stays thin and the walks rarely cross it. The pearl of an identity is its diffusion score. Few outbound attestations per epoch and slashable vouches over proven fraud make bribing honest edges costly. Glacier-slow rank buildup stops a fresh puppet army before audits catch it.
